purpose: A small activity indicator that can be either decorative or a named loading status.
behaviorProvider: Static SVG geometry with CSS motion and optional named status wrapper.

component: With a label, expose role status and that accessible name. Without a label, hide the wrapper from assistive technology so an enclosing status/button can own the message.
Keep the SVG decorative and use token-backed stroke and opacity with size data attributes.
host: Supply a label for standalone loading; omit it when a containing control already describes pending work.
Own actual pending state, completion, cancellation and timeout feedback. Preserve reduced-motion styles.

requirements.statement: With a label, expose role status and that accessible name. Without a label, hide the wrapper from assistive technology so an enclosing status/button can own the message.

Use feedback group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: A spinner provides no percentage, retry behavior or indication that the operation is still progressing.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
